purpose: Replace repository-owned independent-review preparation with a separated panel of advisory agents while preserving the sole human maintainer decision while recording destination constraints without recruiting additional human reviewers.

assessment.candidate_binding: reports must name the exact commit and tree they assessed
assessment.authorization_boundary: panel output is advisory evidence and never an approval, release, publication, registry submission, or issue-closure receipt

gates.accountable_decision: maintainer scientific decision; destination constraints are recorded but do not add repository human reviewers
gates.contingency: retain experimental maturity and schedule targeted remediation and re-review
promote no families; preserve candidate or experimental labels

gates.scope: Rust, R, Julia, and other binding parity
gates.accountable_decision: maintainer acceptance of exact shared-fixture receipts
gates.contingency: record each unavailable binding as unsupported/unverified; do not infer parity

gates.scope: required hosted checks and exact-head assurance
gates.contingency: rebase, refresh checks, and invalidate stale receipts

gates.accountable_decision: maintainer release decision and protected credentials
gates.contingency: prepare a local release packet only; do not tag or publish

gates.scope: arXiv/JOSS, CRAN, PyPI, crates.io, conda-forge, SciCrunch, and other registries
gates.accountable_decision: maintainer submission; destination authority/curation is a service constraint, not an additional repository reviewer
gates.contingency: archive a dated shadow packet and record no submission or acceptance

gates.scope: parent issues, sub-issues, project fields, and closure comments
gates.contingency: leave issues open with an evidence-linked status comment
